video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners why databases are normalized: a customer's city repeated on every order is moved into one row of a customers table

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

city_out.what: The old city in a cell slides up and fades out

city_in.what: The new city slides up into its place

question_marks_enter.what: A violet question mark fades in beside each row that still shows the old city

copy_marks_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind each cell that repeats the same city

copy_ring_draw.what: An outline draws itself around a city cell, violet for the one that was changed and navy for the ones that were missed

copy_ring_exit.what: The outlines around the city cells fade away

detail_chip_enter.what: A white chip with a violet outline fades in around a customer's name and city on an order

detail_travel.what: A customer's name and city travel down from an order into that customer's row of the customers table

detail_chip_exit.what: The travelling name and city fade out as they land

customer_row_enter.what: The customer's ID, name and city fade in on their row of the customers table

old_columns_exit.what: The customer and city text of the orders table fades out

orders_close_up.what: The orders table gets narrower as its customer and city columns close up into one

id_column_enter.what: The header 'customer_id' and an ID number on every order fade in

id_headers_light.what: The headers of the two ID columns turn from pale to violet

moved_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the one city cell in the customers table

moved_ring_exit.what: The outline around the city cell fades away

id_marks_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind the ID of each order that belongs to that customer

id_marks_exit.what: The lavender bands behind the IDs fade away

join_mark_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind the JOIN line of the query
